summary: Cold codegen of two controllers (GasAnalysis, Movement) in chemical_detector.controller. All 81 requirements traced. Flagged: invented constant values and initial values, an invented Tick event for the terminal self-loops and autonomous steps, the odometer realised as a sensor query rather than an event, and the readings-to-target and position-to-direction mappings the spec leaves open.

issues.title: Constant values chosen by the implementer
issues.raw: CD-Const1..6 say the values are configured at startup but give none.
issues.fix_directive: Review THR=1.0, LV=1.0, EVADE_TIME=1, STUCK_PERIOD=1, STUCK_DIST=1.0, OUT_PERIOD=1. They are small integers so CSP-gen's integer ceiling and default type ranges (nat {0..1}, real {0..2}, clock {0..1}) leave every guard able to be both true and false.

issues.title: Tick event added for no-event cycles and terminal self-loops
issues.raw: CD-GA-Beh6 (concludes, processes no further readings) and CD-MV-Beh9 (Found stays halted) name a terminal state with no outgoing transition.
issues.fix_directive: InputEvent.Tick is the control cycle with no other event. CONCLUDED and FOUND self-loop on Tick only, so neither has a Final state or an untriggered self-loop, and the flag is not re-sent. CONCLUDED is used in place of a state named Final.

issues.title: Odometer realised as a sensor query, not an event
issues.raw: CD-Evt3 is typed as an event but describes sampling the distance into d0/d1 inside entry/transition actions.
issues.fix_directive: d0 and d1 are assigned from Sensor.odometer(), a zero-arg sensor method, so the samples are taken inside the action as CD-MV-FR4 and CD-MV-Beh16 describe.

issues.title: What makes a reading 'indicate the target chemical'
issues.raw: CD-Fn1 does not define indication; CD-Fn2 takes the maximum over all values regardless of chemical.
issues.fix_directive: analysis returns gasD iff some value has c equal to the configured target Chem and i > 0. intensity and location follow CD-Fn2/Fn3 literally (all values, first maximum). The target Chem is a Sensor constructor argument, not a model constant.

issues.title: Sensor position to direction mapping
issues.raw: CD-DM7/CD-Fn3 say position maps to a sensing direction via angle(x) but give no mapping.
issues.fix_directive: angle(x) maps 1-based positions to Left, Right, Back, Front in Angle declaration order, cycling beyond 4.

issues.title: Opaque types Intensity and Chem
issues.raw: CD-DM4/CD-DM5 describe opaque types; CD-Const1 needs thr to be an Intensity constant.
issues.fix_directive: Intensity is a double (real) so thr can be a numeric constant and goreq a plain comparison; Chem is a record with a nat identity.

issues.title: Complementary guards written explicitly
issues.raw: CD-GA-FR3 (two sts guards), CD-GA-FR4 (at or above / below thr), CD-MV-Beh17/18 (progress / stuck).
issues.fix_directive: Each pair is p / !p (the gasD branch is !(sts == noGas), equivalent for the two-valued Status), so each guard pair covers every case and neither depends on else-if priority.

issues.title: Initial values of state variables
issues.raw: Only gs (empty) has a specified initial value.
issues.fix_directive: sts=noGas, ins=0, anl=Front, a=Front, d0=d1=0, l=front, T=0.

issues.title: Waiting's during action written as a head-of-mode statement
issues.fix_directive: vehicle.randomWalk() runs at the head of the WAITING block on every cycle spent there; the extracted model may render it as an entry action.

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> T2M -> M2M -> M2T -> verifiers).
